findings.title: To Do time editor places its action footer below the viewport
findings.impact: Footer Save/Cancel/Delete is initially below the viewport and pointer Cancel cannot be activated there. Keyboard focus plus Enter on Cancel can recover, so this is a substantial pointer-access/placement defect, not proof of a keyboard trap or impossible save.
findings.confidence: High: lead measured actual editor416px at top640/bottom1056, footer at1001, in1000px-high viewport at1440 and1133; keyboard Cancel recovery observed.
states: Existing Wednesday time block opened with Enter
findings.observed: The anchored Log time panel begins near y640 in the supplied 1000px-high desktop frame. Its Note field continues to the lower edge and the complete action footer is below that edge. Source clamps top to viewportHeight minus 360px although the rendered editor includes a header, three fields, textarea, gaps, padding and footer, with no maximum-height/scroll treatment. Lead F087/F092 follow-up measured editor height416px, top640/bottom1056 and footer top1001 in1000px-high desktop at both widths. Pointer Cancel offscreen failed; focusing Cancel and pressing Enter safely recovered.
reproduction: Open the existing populated To Do week as Sarah Chen.
Open the Wednesday Unspecified block with Enter.
Observe fields and the visible header Close while the footer is below the viewport in F002.
Do not save or delete the time entry; close/cancel safely after inspection.
findings.expected: An anchored editing surface should keep its primary save/cancel boundary visible or directly reachable within a deliberate bounded scroll area. Positioning should account for actual content height and the fixed app header.
authority: General desktop usability: controls needed to finish or abandon an edit should be visible/reachable
Current DS and app overlay guidance supports viewport containment, but no exact approved To Do anchored-editor reference exists
findings.recommendation: Measure the rendered editor and flip or clamp it within the available content viewport using its actual height. Provide bounded internal scrolling if content or textarea resizing exceeds that space, while retaining a reachable action boundary. Preserve the efficient anchored interaction rather than replacing it with a large modal solely for consistency.
findings.rationale: This addresses the actual placement error caused by a fixed height assumption without changing time values, stage choices, validation or the planning model.
alternatives: A bottom-aligned anchored panel can keep the footer inside the viewport, provided it does not cover the global header or lose its connection to the selected entry.
A different shared overlay may be appropriate only after reviewing workflow/context; it is not required by the current observation.
tradeoffs: Retain visible Close, Escape behaviour and focus return; keyboard recovery has not yet been fully checked.
Re-measure after content/viewport changes and textarea resizing.
Do not change B-owned numeric validation or save/delete semantics while fixing geometry.
findings.rootCause: Anchored editor placement assumes a 360px height while its actual content can exceed that height
occurrences: TimeEntryEditor, populated To Do time blocks

strengths.title: The populated To Do board preserves useful planning context

Each day has explicit planned/done totals; To Do and Done are labelled lanes, and an unspecified entry says Set stage rather than relying only on colour. Completed cards are visually quieter.

Keep text labels and Set stage feedback rather than substituting icons alone.
Repair viewport fit without turning the board into an ordinary task table.
strengths.limits: Friday visibility and scroll affordance remain a separate gap. Header clipping in the scrolled narrow captures is not proof of top-of-page default fit. No drag or save outcome is endorsed.

strengths.title: Shoot keeps planning choices connected without forcing a linear wizard
strengths.observed: Persistent grouped local navigation shows current section and useful counts. People brings contact identity, shoot role and call time into one readable table. Supporting-document copy explicitly separates reference material from native planning coverage.

preserve: Keep local section navigation, counts and role/call-time context.
Retain supporting-document wording rather than shortening it into a misleading existing-plan action.
Do not turn planning into a generic task dashboard or restore the superseded multi-step Creative Plan wizard.
strengths.limits: This does not endorse the clipped question fields, all technical table columns or every scroll/focus path.

strengths.title: On Set gives priority to the information needed on the day
strengths.observed: The Call Sheet gives the general call time strong emphasis beside date, location, weather and key contact. The run-of-day list uses explicit Now/Next/Upcoming labels and quieter completed coverage. Focus mode removes surrounding navigation and keeps a visible Exit focus control.
strengths.whyItWorks: This serves a different task from planning: quickly locating time, place, contact and current capture work while on set.
preserve: Keep strong call-time hierarchy and meaningful status text.
Keep unscheduled coverage available rather than blocking the shoot workflow.
Retain Focus as a deliberate reading mode; B is separately assessing its focus semantics.
strengths.limits: Only listed desktop compositions are assessed. Progress popover occlusion is a separate defect; no claim that all On Set interactions or completion outcomes work.

strengths.title: Shoot editors keep local save boundaries readable
strengths.observed: Current editors use specific titles, labelled fields and visible Cancel/Save actions. Empty question/link drafts keep their primary save action disabled. preserve: Keep the labelled purpose and separate local/whole-dialog actions.
Keep standard-role choice separate from a custom crew role.
Do not add identical shells or dimensions to every editing context.
strengths.limits: No saved question, contact, location, date or supporting document is claimed from opening these views. Time-suggestion menu clipping in F023 remains a separate verification question.

strengths.title: Review keeps picture, time and feedback connected
strengths.whyItWorks: A dark picture area sits beside readable light feedback, with a separately scrollable version library and persistent composer. At 1133 the main player, comments and action boundary remain visible in the supplied captures.
